title: 859. Shortest Path to Get All Keys

examples.explanation: One shortest walk needs eight steps.

hints: Treat (row, col, key-mask) as the full state, since the same cell with different keys allows different futures.
Run breadth-first search from the start state; the first time you pop a state holding all keys, its distance is optimal.
Precompute the target mask from the count of distinct keys, and check doors with bit tests before entering.
